name: Volunteens
what_you_do: Shelve books, help with library programs, watch the kids' computers and run the Friends book shop.
who_can_apply: You must be at least 13 and in grades 7 to 12. You need a Cerritos Library card in good standing.
duration: The page does not state a time commitment
deadline_text: Applications are at the Circulation Desk in March, June and November. No end date is listed. Call to confirm for November 2026.
how_to_apply: Pick up an application at the Circulation Desk in an application month. Then you have an interview. Questions: (562) 916-1338 or volunteen@cerritos.gov.
notes: You must clear a background check, which includes a Live Scan. The page does not name a year for the application months.
